We want to get to know the change agents and the challengers, the rabble-rousers, and the rebels. We want to understand how they got turned on to politics, where their ideas come from, why they chose to step up at this point, and how they plan to change communities, states, and the nation. This podcast extends from a remarkable moment in American politics.
